title: Re-review umq: its tree changed since its READY final review (round 2)
description:
Review the epic umq again, AS INTEGRATED, before the run lands it: its final review (l76, decision 3) judged it READY at c6b0d67c17f9, and the epic branch has changed since — now at 69c9077eab2b, with work that review never saw (a tick closed or a commit pushed after it). This is review round 2, made only because the tree changed; the run lands on YOUR verdict, not the earlier one.

Judge the tree as it stands: READY when the epic does what it said it would, NOT READY naming what blocks it.
